key_insight: The paper builds the first large-scale spin-polarized electronic-structure and bonding database for more than 2,500 stable halide double perovskites, revealing many composition-tunable semiconducting and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: This dataset gives materials engineers a searchable foundation for screening perovskites with targeted band gaps, magnetic behavior, and bonding characteristics for photovoltaics and related devices.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculated DOS for Cs2BB'X6 compounds (X = I, Br, Cl, F)
Applied the τ tolerance factor to identify stable double perovskites
Performed Lobster bonding analysis and provided UMAP visualizations plus an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The database includes spin-polarized DOS for over 2,500 compounds, with 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic systems.
watch_item: The results are computational predictions, so experimental synthesis stability and device performance may differ from the screened database candidates.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
